record.edic_text:
507 ano {an'-o}

from 473; TDNT - 1:376,63; adv

AV - above 5, up 2, high 1, brim 1; 9

1) up, upwards, above, on high
2) of the quarters of the heaven, northward
3) of countries, inland, up from the coast
4) of time, formerly

same.cexp: 從上面；再一次；從開始；長久或從起初
首先，上面（說過的話）；上座
＜所＞在…上；勝過，管；多於；＜副＞在上面
